encode_3d_boxes_with_residual_coder: encode 3D bounding boxes relative to anchors using ResidualCoder.encode_torch with optional sincos angle encoding
decode_3d_boxes_with_residual_coder: decode residual box encodings back to 3D bounding boxes using ResidualCoder.decode_torch from anchors
decode_boxes_with_previous_residual_deco: decode 3D bounding box encodings using PreviousResidualDecoder.decode_torch static method with anchor offsets
decode_roi_boxes_with_previous_residual_: decode ROI 3D bounding box encodings using PreviousResidualRoIDecoder.decode_torch with inverted heading angle
encode_point_residual_boxes: encode 3D boxes relative to point anchors using PointResidualCoder.encode_torch with mean size per class
